summary.text: Conspiracy takes place in the city of Paliano, where schemers trade betrayals as the withered King Brago, begged by Selvala to die, is killed and then returns as King Eternal when the Custodi announce that he has risen.

Marchesa and her business partner Ervos Trax each plan the other's death at a private dinner, and Ervos poisons himself, while the inventor Muzzio uses his recording constructs to frame and ruin the board members who stand in his way until his motion for vice chancellor carries.
Meanwhile on Zendikar, Nissa Revane survives the Eldrazi swarm that destroys her Joraga tribe and joins Hamadi's expedition, where she learns that Shaya means Worldwaker.
